humanSummary: This repo has no test command configured, so LCARS cannot prove a ticket's work — and did not hire anyone to attempt it. Establish a test runner, or point LCARS at one with `lcars update --test-command`.
technicalDetail:
Ticket t-001 cannot start: no test command is configured for this repo, so LCARS has no way to prove any work — every ticket is proven by RUNNING its tests (red on the parent commit, green on the tip).
This reads as a greenfield repo. LCARS's test-readiness verdict: ◇ NO TEST SYSTEMS FOUND — a greenfield repo; the first mission's engineering crew will establish them.
No worker was hired: a paid session spent here could not have been proven either way.
What to do next: establish a test runner in this repo (add a test framework and a command that runs it) — then set it with `lcars update --test-command '<command>'` (or `lcars update --fix-tests`, which walks you through it).
